title: Dynamic variability of CO2 emissions from agricultural canal-lake systems in cold and arid regions
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00912J, Paper

Ying Wang, Wenzhu Yang, Yan Jiao
Agricultural canal-lake systems are potential hotspots for greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions; however, existing studies have largely focused on natural water bodies or single-type water bodies, with limited research on the continuum.
